entry.name: jit.lumakey
entry.digest: Key based on distance from a luminance value
entry.description: The jit.lumakey object measures the chromatic distance of each of the left input's cells (pixels) with a reference luminance calulated by the formula lum = (ascale * alpha_value) + (rscale * r_value) + (gscale * g_value) + (bscale * b_value).
